instruction.text: What is a settlement? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: A settlement is a place where a community of people have gathered to live and ((++work argue)) together.
It is a place where people have chosen to build their houses, ((++businesses bouncy_castles)) and any other facilities needed for daily life.

hint.text: A facility is a building that is made or used for a specific activity.
hint.label: Facilities

atoms.b: There are lots of different types of settlements that range in ((++size bigness)), population and function.

instruction.text: Read the text and select the matching settlement.

atoms.a: A hamlet is one of the smallest types of settlements, with only a few houses.
A village is a small settlement, usually with a church, a school, some shops and a village hall.
A town is a larger settlement, often with a shopping centre and a train station.
A city is the largest type of settlement, with a large population and lots of different facilities.

instruction.text: Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: Some smaller settlements are still cities because they have a cathedral.

feedback.end: In the past, if a cathedral was built in a settlement, it automatically became a city. Nowadays, only the King or Queen can give a town city status.

atoms.a: A city is much smaller than a hamlet.
Hamlets and villages usually have lots of shops.
What types of facilities do larger settlements usually include?

feedback.finish: Larger settlements, such as cities and towns, often include facilities that are not commonly found in hamlets or villages.
